name: project-tranche-orchestrator
description: Turn docs-scaffold project state into one governed execution tranche managed through a single primary agent.

interface.shortDescription: Derive, delegate, review, and document one tranche through a single primary agent in collaborative or autonomous mode.
interface.longDescription: Reads standardized project docs, derives the next executable tranche, optionally collaborates with the user before delegation, delegates bounded work to subagents, enforces a doc-and-code review gate, and writes status updates back into the existing governance docs without creating a second source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Orchestrate the next tranche from this repo's project docs in collaborative mode.
Review the current tranche and tell me if it is ready to advance.
Split the next tranche into safe subagent assignments.
